function: Joint learned CSI feedback compression, beamforming and IRS effective-capacitance control; the CSI is not reconstructed at the BS (p. 2-3, p. 5).
system: FDD downlink MIMO-OFDM: BS ULA with N=2 or 12 antennas, passive reflecting IRS UPA with up to 36 or 144 elements, single-antenna UE, 3.5 GHz (p. 3, 11).
method: Bayesian reinforcement learning (soft actor-critic variant with CSI encoder, actor, Q and V networks) for a POMDP; offline training from a replay buffer (p. 5-10).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing channels, urban scenario O1 at 3.5 GHz: BS 4 as BS, BS 5 as IRS; 7772 train, 580 validation, 1740 test samples (p. 11).
test_conditions: Train, validation and test episodes (134/10/30) come from the same O1 area, direct link blocked; test sweeps IRS elements, feedback bits and capacitance noise (p. 11-14).
baselines: Classical: perfect-CSI alternating optimization (continuous, discrete) [21], random IRS and beamforming. Learned: RIS-CsiNet [32]. Ablations: ideal-IRS, with CSI reconstruction, perfect-CSI variants (p. 12-13).
metrics: Average downlink data rate (bps/Hz), average feedback bits, NMSE of CSI reconstruction for one variant, FLOPs (p. 12-14).
complexity: FLOPs: 6114NK + 1534M + 130560, against fourth-power scaling of RIS-CsiNet and AO; FLOPs only, no runtime (p. 14-15, Table III).
q1_support: p. 11: "on the DeepMIMO channel realizations [39], a widely recognized dataset for IRS algorithm evaluation"
q2_support: p. 11: "we distribute the number of samples to 7772 (134 episodes) for training, 580 (10 episodes) for validation, and 1740 (30 episodes) for testing"; held-out episodes of the same O1 data. Missing: no test in another scenario, band, array size or dataset.
q3_support: p. 12: "Perfect CSI with alternating optimization (AO) [21]" and "RIS-CsiNet [32]", with a random configuration; Fig. 7 (p. 13) compares the average data rate of all of them.
q4_support: p. 14: "we derive the FLOPs for the CSI encoder and actor modules as follows"; Table III (p. 15) gives 6114NK + 1534M + 130560.
q5_support: p. 11: "on the DeepMIMO channel realizations [39], a widely recognized dataset for IRS algorithm evaluation"; the paper gives no link to its own code or data.
notes: Area 3 chosen over area 2: the method does CSI feedback (area 2) and beamforming with IRS control (area 3), but the main metric is the average data rate (Figs. 7-8), while feedback bits are a budget. The IRS is reflecting, with a capacitance-controlled circuit model (p. 3). q5 is met only because DeepMIMO is a public dataset; no code link is given. q2 is 0: the capacitance-noise sweep on p. 13-14 perturbs the output of the same trained model, like an error sweep, not a new condition.
